Countable Choice is already explicitly assumed and suffices for the affine scaling supplier. Removed the extra attribution; the Jacobi endpoint, pyramid Jacobian, normal derivative degree and geometric estimates are unchanged.

The theorem already assumes Countable Choice globally, so step 4.1 is licensed. Corrected F8 and axiom_use to name both inherited uses without changing the claim or proof.

The Galerkin clause assumed only u in V, not a(u,v)=F(v). For zero load every Galerkin solution is zero; a nonzero weighted-analytic u in H01 therefore has constant nonzero error despite exponentially small best approximation. Made exact variational solvability and the bounded load explicit in the Statement, F5, and step 5.1. The approximation claim, weighted class, grading and rates are preserved.

The complete cited interpolation supplier proves exactly these bounds in Proof 1.1, not merely in its comparison Statement: ||w||_E <= C(h^-1/2||w||_K+h^1/2|w|H1) and ||d_tau w||_E <= C(h^-1/2|w|H1+h^1/2|w|H2). It derives the tangential trace identity by smooth H2 density and the H1 trace theorem. F1 explicitly points to that local proof, and ell_E comparable to h_K gives J_K,R_K <= C(h^-1||w||+|w|H1+h|w|H2), licensing both refinements. No defect or edit is needed.
